section.sectionSummaryBrief: Through Dovid composing the psalm "A Prayer of Moshe" for all Jews, even simple people gain the power to reveal their inner wealth and fill the lack in Malchus and the world completely.
section.t: And 4)
And it may be said,
that through Dovid writing the psalm "A Prayer of Moshe" in the book of Tehillim, which is said by all of Israel,
also by simple people,
power is given to each and every one of Israel,
to reveal the aspect of wealth that is within him
(from the aspect of Moshe that is in each one of Israel95),
and through this — to fill the lack of Malchus and of the world,
the filling of the lack completely,
so that there will be no place in the world where the revelation of Elokus does not shine.
And this may be connected with the statement of the Midrash96
on the explanation of "Ish HaElokim,"
at the time he ascended to the firmament he was "ish," and at the time he descended from the firmament he was "Elokim,"
and it is explained by the Rebbe, my father-in-law, in the aforementioned sicha
(which was brought at the beginning of the maamar)97,
that "Adam"
(Mochin98)
is higher than "Ish"
(Midos98),
and what the Midrash says, "at the time he ascended to the firmament he was 'ish'" teaches that even during prayer,
when one contemplates the most elevated levels and attains them well,
and ascends to the firmament,
he must remember that he is "ish,"
that he has midos that need to be refined and purified,
and through this,
at the time he descends from the firmament
(after prayer)
he is "Elokim,"
"Elokim" from the term of judgment99
and "Elokim" from the term of strength and might100,
meaning he possesses strength and might to execute judgment upon himself so that his conduct in practice will be as it should be.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Since Moshe's aspect is wealth, the work of "Ish HaElokim" relates to wealth, paralleling the three levels of Memale, Sovev, and Atzmus Ein Sof with their counterparts in the soul.
section.t: And according to what was explained, that the matter of Moshe
(which is emphasized in "A Prayer of Moshe")
is that Moshe was wealthy,
it must be said,
that the service of "Ish HaElokim" is related to the matter of wealth.
And the explanation is,
that the three matters above
(Memale,
Sovev, and Ein Sof that is above Sovev)
have their parallel in man.
For the revelations of the soul are parallel to the revelations of Memale and Sovev,
and the essence of the soul is parallel to the Atzmus of Ein Sof.
And just as above,

from the perspective of the revelations of Memale and Sovev there is room for the existence of that which is outside of Elokus, and it is specifically from the perspective of the Atzmus of Ein Sof that the true reality of all existences is Elokus
(as above, section 9),
so too is it in the service of man,
that in order for the contemplation during prayer to be in a manner that affects his conduct throughout the entire day,
"Ish HaElokim,"
it is through his prayer being connected with the essence of the soul,
Moshe,
wealth.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: In Moshe's prayer for Knesses Yisrael, the two aspects of drawing from Atzmus Ein Sof to elevate Malchus and then drawing Atzmus into Malchus correspond to the two aspects of "Ish HaElokim" in man's service.
section.t: A)
And to add,
it is explained in the maamar101,
that in Moshe's prayer for Knesses Yisrael,
which is Sefiras HaMalchus,
there are two matters.
The drawing of an illumination from the Atzmus of Ein Sof, through which the elevation of Malchus is possible
(from below to above)
into the Atzmus of Ein Sof,
and through this there is subsequently a drawing of the Atzmus into Malchus
(from above to below).
And it may be said,
that these two matters
(in Malchus)
are through the two matters in "Ish HaElokim"
[at the time he ascended to the firmament he was "ish" and at the time he descended from the firmament he was "Elokim"]
in the service of man.
For through the service of "at the time he ascended to the firmament he was 'ish',"
that even during the contemplation of prayer he remembers that he has midos that need to be refined and purified,
and that his prayer being in this manner is because his prayer is connected with the essence of the soul
(as above, section 10),
this is the drawing of an illumination from the essence of the soul
(from above to below)
through which the lower matters within him are elevated to prayer — through this, an illumination is drawn from the Atzmus of Ein Sof to elevate and raise Malchus to its root in the Atzmus.
And through the service of "at the time he descended from the firmament he was 'Elokim',"
that through the prayer being connected with the essence of the soul, it affects his conduct throughout the entire day,
this is the drawing and revelation of the essence of the soul into the lower matters within him — through this, there is the drawing and revelation of the Atzmus in Malchus,
decree that it be built in an eternal building.
